rules: When product positioning, script, voiceover timing, storyboard, CTA, and visual requirements are approved for asset production.
When the truthful promo visuals and their source or edit records are complete and ready for independent review.
When visuals need correction for truthfulness, UI readability, callout accuracy, aspect ratio, sensitive data, or no-added-text compliance.
When the visual package passes review and is ready for audio, captions, motion assembly, and final export.
When final assembly, optional captions or audio-led segments, export, and QA are complete and the coordinator needs delivery status.
